title: Hearing on keeping Mitchell-Lama housing affordable
summary: The Council's Finance and Housing and Buildings Committees held a joint oversight hearing on financial tools to preserve affordability and stability in the Mitchell-Lama housing program, which covers 269 developments and over 105,000 units citywide. The hearing examined rent increases such as a proposed 30%-plus hike at Tracey Towers in the Bronx, low enrollment in rent freeze programs like SCRIE and DRIE, and findings from a 2026 state audit of building conditions and financial oversight. A related resolution, Res. No. 83, calls on the state Legislature and governor to pass A.6432/S.4236 to create an independent agency protecting Mitchell-Lama residents' rights.
